summary: Locale resolver. Sets flag bits on the dword_8D3FB0 validation word, queries the Win32 GetUserDefaultLCID API, stores the returned locale ID into both dword_8D3FB4 and the Locale global, and returns the same value. Called by sub_58FD90 (0058fd90) during locale setup.

local_names.result: LCID returned by GetUserDefaultLCID, stored in two globals and returned

operations.description: Sets flag bits on the low word of dword_8D3FB0: LOWORD(dword_8D3FB0) = dword_8D3FB0 | 0x104
Calls GetUserDefaultLCID (import at 0x0059E134) to obtain the user default locale ID
dword_8D3FB4 = result, storing the resolved locale ID
Locale = result, storing the same locale ID in the Locale global
Returns the locale ID obtained from GetUserDefaultLCID
Invoked by sub_58FD90 (0058fd90) as part of locale initialization

unresolved: The meaning of the 0x104 flag bits on dword_8D3FB0 is not established from this packet; it may mark the locale as resolved or validated
The exact role of the Locale global versus dword_8D3FB4 is not distinguished by this packet
